name: Wood Elf
description: As a wood elf, you have keen senses and intuition, and your fleet feet carry you quickly and stealthily through your native forests. Wood elves are reclusive and distrusting of non-elves in many settings.

features.name: Age
features.description: Although elves reach physical maturity at about the same age as humans, the elven understanding of adulthood goes beyond physical growth to encompass worldly experience. An elf typically claims adulthood and an adult name around the age of 100 and can live to be 750 years old.
features.snippet: Elves claim adulthood around 100 and can live to be 750 years old.

features.name: Size
features.description: Elves range from under 5 to over 6 feet tall and have slender builds. Your size is Medium.

features.name: Speed
features.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.
features.snippet: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

features.name: Trance
features.description: Elves do not need to sleep. Instead, they enter a meditation known as "trance." Instead of the normal 6-8 hours a human requires, elves need to only trance for 4 hours a day. However, the duration of a long rest does not change. During a rest, you may enter a Trance to take an additional rest move so long as you are not interrupted.
features.snippet: You trance for 4 hours instead of sleeping. During a rest, you may enter a Trance to take an additional rest move if not interrupted.

features.name: Uncanny Reactions
features.description: When you roll Initiative, you may expend a Heroic Inspiration to make the result your maximum possible value. This can only be done if you haven't rolled yet.
features.snippet: When you roll Initiative, you may expend a Heroic Inspiration to make the result your maximum possible value (before rolling).

features.name: Languages
features.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and Elvish.
features.snippet: You can speak, read, and write Common and Elvish.
